messages:
maria: kicking off gateway priming for router service (svc-router) — target version pinned: v2.2.1-prod. change window 03:00-03:30 UTC. warming 5% -> 25% edge buckets over 15m.

sam: ack. rolling across us-west-2 and eu-central first, then us-east. will monitor qps and 95p latency.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary job id 827391. pinned image: redwood/router:v2.2.1-prod. healthchecks: /healthz ok, kv-cache warm ok.

jules: quick note — session-affinity cookie TTL = 45s; draining lambda set to 60s so no orphaned KV.

lee: FYI, I've added a temporary route rule in lb-config: 
```
route {
  match: header("x-rl-version") == "v2.2.1"
  weight: 100
}
```
we'll shift weights by policy, not manual swaps.

maria: initial 5% stable for 10m. if errors < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < 10ms, move to 25%.

ops-oncall: watching alert channels. Pager policy: if error-rate > 1% for 3m or p95 > baseline + 50ms, abort and rollback to v2.1.9.

deploy-bot: canary progressed: 5% -> 25% (at 1976543240). metrics:
- errors 0.12%
- p95 +6ms
- cpu per-pod +8%

sam: looks good. proceeding to 60% over next 8m. I'll keep session-affinity drain extended during the ramp.

jules: tagging this rollout in release notes: \"router: v2.2.1 — kernel optimize, kv-cache warm-up, session ttl tweak\". Noting known risk: slight CPU bump on long-seq requests.

maria: hold on: I'm seeing a flurry of 503s on one edge pool (edge-09). pausing shift at 60% and pinning to 25% while we investigate. rolling back edge-09 to v2.1.9.

deploy-bot: rollback command executed for edge-09 -> v2.1.9 (action id 827392). global traffic pinned to 25% for v2.2.1. alert created: INC-2021.

lee: root cause: TLS renegotiation failure with older gateway HW on edge-09. patch queued, but we should not proceed full cutover until patched.

maria: agree. cancel remaining staged ramps. I've updated the release ticket with rollback notes and change window extension request to 04:30 UTC. tagging @product and @support for customer impact.

sam: copying release notes into console and pinning version v2.2.1 to 25% in routing policy. will schedule a targeted retry for edge-09 after HW patch.

ops-oncall: closing loop: set automatic fallback to v2.1.9 if errors spike on any edge pool during next 2h. monitoring continues.

jules: end status: partial rollout (25%), edge-09 rolled back -> v2.1.9, follow-up action: HW patch + verify 503 fix, then resume ramp. noted in changelog.

maria: thanks team. will hold final cutover until patch verified. :thumbsup:
